atlas_figures.name: S_batch_reuse_one_worker
atlas_figures.scope: Each marker is one workload, method and environment. Filled/open markers identify Linux/Windows; smaller/larger markers identify Python 3.11/3.14. Within each method, lanes run L311, L314, W311, W314 from top to bottom. Recreate/retain ratios above one favour retaining state. The main batch figure shows four-worker reuse.
atlas_figures.title: Workspace reuse with one worker

application_protocol.adapter_scope: contiguous dtype conversion, finite check, solver public API, int32 pair normalization, cardinality check
application_protocol.evaluation: IoU>=0.5 motmetrics supplied-box metrics, no official class/ignore policy; outside timing
application_protocol.name: Real sequences with gt and rfdetr_nano detections
application_protocol.objective_validation_note: exact nonzero-gap counts and maximum gaps retained; large gated costs can inflate relative tolerances; tolerance-pass is not exact equality
application_protocol.reinitialization: fresh tracker after each warmup; SORT global ID counter reset; module hooks restored
application_protocol.replay_scope: same full captured corpus for every solver; conversion to corpus dtype outside timing; adapter work included
application_protocol.statistics: median and IQR across repeated whole-sequence/corpus mean times; descriptive, not significance or generalization intervals
application_protocol.stock_tracker_semantics: Centroid distance gate and SORT IoU post-filter/unique-feasible bypass preserved; no finite-limit objective substitution
application_protocol.timing_scope: sum of sequential tracker.update calls; Person construction, serialization, evaluation, decode and detector inference excluded
